name: OpenPanel
line: Tracks website and product events with replay and self-hosted options.

free.text: Free self-host; OSS: active public OSI repo + backlink; 2.5M Cloud events/mo

pv.math: Billed by events. Assumes one screen_view per pageview and no other events. Open-source use is eligible for up to 2.5M events a month. Ordinary Cloud starts at $2.50 a month. This 10K-event band costs $5 a month.
